fields.name: voice_name
fields.label: Voice Name
fields.tooltip: Name for the locked persona — becomes the .qvoice filename stem. Reused across every future TTS render.

fields.name: style_instruction
fields.label: Style Instruction
fields.tooltip: The voice description — becomes the VoiceDesign prompt (e.g. 'A warm female voice with a British accent').

fields.name: qvoice
fields.label: Voice (.qvoice)
fields.tooltip: Pre-computed speaker embedding (.qvoice/.voice — the voice-lock card exports these). Present = synthesize with THIS voice instead of the preset one.

fields.name: voice_pca_strengths
fields.label: PCA Steering
fields.tooltip: JSON knobs over the embedding's principal components, e.g. {"pca_pc1.dir": 0.5} — subtle voice direction without re-designing the persona.
